description: This file implements the ArmorComponent class, which manages damage modifiers based on location and type of damage in a game. It includes methods for calculating non-locational and locational damage modifiers, and applies damage modifications based on hit location, angle, and other factors.

classes.name: ArmorComponent
classes.description: A component class that handles damage modifications based on armor and hit location.

methods.name: GetNonLocationalDamageMod
methods.description: Returns the damage modifier for non-locational damage regions.

methods.name: GetLocationalDamageMod
methods.description: Calculates and returns the damage modifier based on hit angle and height.

methods.name: HandleApplyDamageModifier
methods.description: Applies damage modifications based on hit location, angle, and other parameters.
